name: Function roulette
notes: Live: every press of hotkey 1 turns one more of the game's busiest functions off (a return at its start, so the game skips it): gravity, collision, an enemy's brain, the scroll. Watch what stops. The crash guard turns back on one that breaks the game; Back to Normal turns them all back on. Needs the functions the game calls: play a moment first. For picking them one by one, open Functions in the ROM section.
